text:
Maya (CS): Quick capture from Shoreline pilot call — hitting two product asks:
- persistent per-route cost breakdown (they need to show C-suite per-feature spend)
- ability to pin quantization profile per-tenant (they saw quality drop on 4-bit at scale)

Liam (CS): Got it. Was this during onboarding or after steady traffic? Any logs/screens?

Maya (CS): Mid-onboarding, ramping traffic to ~30 rps. Attached screenshot of latency spike, and a short log excerpt:
```
2026-03-02T15:12:03Z request_id=... route=/generate latency_ms=820
2026-03-02T15:12:03Z kv_cache_miss=true batch_size=1
```

Priya (Product): Thanks, @Maya. Two quick asks from product: 1) severity (P0/P1?) 2) would a per-route cost CSV export suffice for Shoreline? If yes, we can add a P1 ticket.

Maya (CS): Marking P1 for now. CSV export + UI toggle to download per-route cost is what they requested. Also asked for an API to pin quant profile per-customer.

Gabe (PM): I can own the API pinning scope. @Priya can we add fields: customer_id, model_variant, quant_profile, effective_from? Example payload:
```
POST /internal/tenant-override
{
  "customer_id": "shoreline-001",
  "model_variant": "redwood-3xl-q4",
  "quant_profile": "q4_optim",
  "effective_from": "2026-03-05T00:00:00Z"
}
```

Priya (Product): LGTM. Filing product ticket and linking to CS notes. @Liam can you confirm renewal risk and whether we should offer a short-term Dedicated pool while we ship pinning?

Liam (CS): Renewal risk: elevated but not critical — customer is enterprise trialing for a month. I'd offer a temporary Dedicated burst (sales ok with one-week trial). I'll loop in sales.

OnboardBot: Summary created and synced to /cs-notes/shoreline-pilot-2026-03-02 (auto)

Maya (CS): Thanks all — next step: @Gabe create ticket for tenant override API, @Priya product ticket for per-route export UI, @Liam confirm Dedicated burst with sales. I'll update the chase doc by EOD. :thumbsup:
